messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — want to finalize the design partner intake for the VPC+KMS private beta. Goal: 6-8 partners, 4-week onboarding runway. Need agreement on: recruitment criteria, feedback cadence, and launch acceptance gates. Can we lock this today?
Riley (Solutions): +1. suggest we target 2 infra-heavy startups, 2 regulated enterprise teams, 2 mid-market with self-host needs. small technical teams only.
Jo (DevEx): Agree on technical profile. Also we need a 1-pager runbook for partner engineers (onboarding checklist + minimal support matrix). I can draft.
Marc (Eng): Heads-up: eng needs clear rollback policies and telemetry we can collect during onboarding. We should define 3 auto-fail signals (e.g., 95p latency spike, KV cache miss rate, OOMs) before a partner is allowed to go live.
Priya (SRE): For SLA/ops: can we guarantee 2 business-hour triage for beta partners during the 4w window? We need on-call coverage and an incident runbook specific to private deployments.
Ken (Legal): NDAs + DPA addendum for private deployments — legal review will take ~3 business days. Also need a list of required logs/data access restrictions.
Maya (Customer Success): I can recruit from our queue — prefer partners that already did proofs of concept. Will need a short outreach script and incentive (e.g., 3 months free Dedicated credits).
Aisha (PM): Cool — trying to keep the scope small. Draft recruitment screener below, feedback?
Aisha (PM): ```
1) Do you manage private infrastructure (VPC or on-prem)? Yes/No
2) Are you comfortable running pre-release binaries and providing debug access? Yes/No
3) Primary use case: (short text)
4) Team size of infra/ML engineers: (number)
5) Regulatory constraints (if any): (short text)
6) Would you join weekly async feedback + one 60m sync per week? Yes/No
```
Riley (Solutions): That covers it. Add one question: "Can you provide a test dataset or representative queries?" helps eval.
Jo (DevEx): For the runbook, I'll include a minimal `checks.sh` snippet partners can run and a troubleshooting section. Example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://private.redwood/api/v1/health`
Marc (Eng): For telemetry I'll propose these gates: 
- latency_p95 < X ms over 1h
- kv_cache_miss_rate < Y%
- no OOM/Restart in last 24h
We can make X/Y numbers after we baseline with the first partner.
Priya (SRE): +1. Also: add a capacity throttle policy so partners can't saturate Dedicated pools during onboarding. That avoids noisy-neighbor risk.
Ken (Legal): We'll prepare a one-page addendum template. For partners in EU, include data residency checkbox.
Maya (Customer Success): Outreach script suggestion: short intro, benefits (early influence, credits, dedicated support), ask for screener answers + availability. I can share templates.
Aisha (PM): Proposed feedback cadence: weekly async (Slack thread + Miro board) + 60m sync every Friday. Deliverables from partner: onboarding checklist completion, demo of end-to-end flow, one short post-onboarding eval (quality+perf).
Riley (Solutions): Make sure we capture qualitative notes about prompt/behavior regressions (not just perf). We should bucket feedback into: infra, perf, UX, accuracy.
Jo (DevEx): How will we collect logs and evals? Suggest two things: 1) short eval harness repo (private) partners can run; 2) shared spreadsheet with prompt sets + results.
Marc (Eng): Acceptance criteria for GA decision: all partners pass onboarding gates and no major regressions on our eval prompts across the board; 80% of partners report first-week usable performance. If any partner hits a major perf regression we pause rollout.
Priya (SRE): Ops SLA for beta: 99.5% availability for control plane, support triage within 2 business hours, and documented rollback steps within runbook.
Ken (Legal): Also require data minimization — partners confirm they will not send PII unless covered by the DPA addendum.
Aisha (PM): Action items: 
- Jo: runbook draft by Tue EOD
- Ken: NDA/DPA addendum template by Wed
- Maya: first outreach batch (10 candidates) by Wed EOD
- Marc/Priya: telemetry/gating numbers baseline with partner1 in week1
- Riley: outreach screener + script, add dataset question
I'll own partner selection and schedule kickoff.
Maya (Customer Success): Noted — I'll start messaging customers tonight, will ping results here.
Jo (DevEx): Drafted the runbook skeleton in the docs repo, sharing link in #docs when ready.
calendar-bot: Scheduled "Private Beta Kickoff: partner-ops" for 2024-11-07 16:00 (UTC) — invite sent to attendees.
Aisha (PM): Thanks all. If nobody objects by EOD I'll lock this plan and start invites. :thumbsup:
